title: After the launch, «اعرض صفحة قريباً» answers every page 200 with X-Robots-Tag: noindex, so one press drops the launched site from search
evidence: Contract line 18: `| «قريباً» | soon | a soon design, 200 |`; line 28 offers «اعرض صفحة قريباً» in every state other than soon, including after «افتح الموقع». The gate serves the soon design through worker.js (line 32: `status: maintenance ? 503 : 200, headers: page.headers`), whose headers come from artifacts/soon/site/_headers `/*` (line 12: `X-Robots-Tag: noindex`); the contract does not change _headers. Live today: `curl -sS -D - https://anas.studio/no-such-page` -> `HTTP/1.1 200 OK` ... `x-robots-tag: noindex`. Google: "When Googlebot crawls that page and extracts the tag or header, Google will drop that page entirely from Google Search results" (https://developers.google.com/search/docs/crawling-indexing/block-indexing).
impact: Once the site is launched and indexed, the owner pressing «اعرض صفحة قريباً» (e.g. to hide the shop for a few days instead of using «صيانة») makes every gated URL (/, /store/*, /book, /journal/*...) answer 200 + noindex with the same soon page; each URL Googlebot recrawls in that window is removed from Google Search, and coming back needs a recrawl and re-index (days to weeks) after «افتح الموقع». Even without the header, 200 with identical content on every URL reads as soft 404s.
proposed_fix: Keep D47's three states but fix the answer: once site_state has ever been open (record launched_at in the row, or let P11 set the gate variable), the gate answers soon like maintenance (503 + Retry-After, the soon design as the body, no X-Robots-Tag: noindex); keep 200 + noindex only before the first open, where link previews need a 200. Drop the noindex line from the gate's responses after the launch in any case. Alternative, an owner call: withdraw «اعرض صفحة قريباً» after the launch (open <-> maintenance only).
prior_overlap: none (AUDIT-1/2 predate the soon page; the MAINT-1 review's contract findings did not cover post-launch soon)

title: The domain's front page rides on the Workers Free daily allowance: past 100,000 script runs in a UTC day, / shows Cloudflare Error 1027 until midnight UTC, and nothing records this
evidence: Every request that is not a file runs the script: live `/`, `/no-such-page`, `/robots.txt`, `/_headers` and `/wp-login.php` all answer with `Set-Cookie: soon=...` from worker.js line 35 (2026-10-07), so each page view of / and every scanner or bot path costs one run; /robots.txt is not a file in site/, so even crawlers' robots fetches run it and get HTML. The Worker is reachable only through Custom Domains (wrangler.toml lines 24-32: `custom_domain = true`), where it is the origin. Docs: Workers Free accounts have 100,000 requests a day, 'When a Worker exceeds this limit, Cloudflare returns Error 1027', and the fail-open choice is set per route (https://developers.cloudflare.com/workers/platform/limits/#daily-requests). DECISIONS.md line 87: 'No Workers plan is needed (D32).'
impact: If Anas shares the link with his audience and a day's visits plus bot traffic pass 100,000 script runs (counted per account, with any other Worker or Pages Function there), visitors to anas.studio get Cloudflare's 'temporarily rate limited' page instead of the soon page for the rest of the UTC day (until 03:00 in Riyadh). The same allowance is what the P11 gate will spend on every page view.
proposed_fix: Record the ceiling in artifacts/soon/README.md and in the P11 traffic check, and let the owner choose: accept it, or Workers Paid for the launch period. Cheap reduction meanwhile: add a real site/robots.txt (served as a file, no script run, and a text answer for crawlers).

title: The launch sequence never sets the gate's fallback MODE to open, so after «افتح الموقع» any failed state read puts «قريباً» (200, noindex) over the launched site
evidence: Line 43 makes the fallback safe only if someone flips it: 'with no answer yet it uses `MODE`, which is `soon` before the launch and `open` from the launch (... P11 sets it), so a database that cannot answer never puts «قريباً» over the launched site'. The launch sequences an operator follows stop at the owner's press: line 49 'put the gate ... in front of the Pages project ...; take anas.studio and www off ...; then the owner opens the site with «افتح الموقع». The Worker anas-studio-soon is deleted ...', and the same in artifacts/soon/README.md line 63 and PLANS/WORK-PACKAGES.md line 143 (`grep -c MODE PLANS/WORK-PACKAGES.md` -> 0). wrangler.toml line 21 ships `MODE = "soon"`.
impact: Launched with the fallback still `soon`: every isolate whose first read of site_state fails (a Supabase incident, a paused or slow project past the 1.5 s timeout, a wrong key after a restore) answers every gated page with a soon design, 200 and X-Robots-Tag: noindex, for at least 30 s and for as long as the reads keep failing. The static site would otherwise stay readable through a Supabase outage; instead visitors see «قريباً» on a live site, and crawls in that window drop pages from Google (SOON-01's mechanism).
proposed_fix: Add the step to all three launch sequences (contract line 49, README 'At launch', WORK-PACKAGES P11): right after «افتح الموقع» and the domain check, redeploy the gate with MODE=open (deploy.cjs --mode=open), and add it to P11's hosted acceptance ('the fallback when the read fails' tested after the flip, expecting the site, not «قريباً»).
